data.desc: VirnetX Holding Corporation is an Internet security software and technology company specializing in patented Zero Trust Network Access ('ZTNA') for secure network communications. The company's solutions, including its Secure Domain Name Registry and its flagship platform, VirnetX One, and products like War Room and VirnetX Matrix, are designed to be device and location independent and enable secure, real-time communication environments for U.S. defense, intelligence, and government agencies, as well as enterprise applications and critical infrastructure. The company also offers Digital Engineering services that align with defense strategies, including its comprehensive Cyber Threat Intelligence and assessment services and Model-Based System Engineering processes.
